# Slides Thief

> Browser-local web app and Python CLI that turn angled photos of slides or documents into perspective-corrected images and a clean PDF.

Browser processing is local; source photos are not uploaded. Corner order is top-left, top-right, bottom-right, bottom-left. Web UI languages: zh-CN, zh-TW, en, es, fr, de, ja, ko, pt-BR. License: MIT.

Usage analytics is on by default after saved preferences are checked and can be disabled in the About dialog. App events contain counts, corner-adjustment events, and fixed error codes, never filenames, file sizes, or raw errors. Disable automatic file-download measurement in the Google Analytics data stream.

<!-- BEGIN GENERATED: llms-core-en -->
- Web formats: JPEG / JPG, PNG, WebP, HEIC / HEIF. CLI formats: JPEG / JPG, PNG, TIFF, HEIC / HEIF.
- Web source formats: 16:9, 4:3, 16:10, A4, Letter, and custom ratios.
- Web PDF layouts: match the selected source format, physical A4, A3, Letter paper, or a custom page size.
<!-- END GENERATED: llms-core-en -->

## Start

- [Web app](https://slidesthief.com/): Interactive local straightening and PDF export

- [Documentation index](https://slidesthief.com/docs/llms.txt): Curated index for the docs under /docs/
- [Expanded reference](https://slidesthief.com/llms-full.txt): One-file operating summary for agents that fetch a single document

## Docs

- [CLI contract](https://slidesthief.com/docs/cli.md): Batch command, inputs, outputs, ratios, and options
- [FAQ](https://slidesthief.com/docs/faq.md): Uploads, formats, ratios, corner order, languages, and enhancement modes
- [JSON inputs and outputs](https://slidesthief.com/docs/output-schema.md): Detection report, manual review data, and corner-file shape
- [Examples](https://slidesthief.com/docs/examples.md): Standard 16:9 batch and a manual correction pass
- [Privacy notice](https://slidesthief.com/privacy.md): Markdown alternate of the public privacy page
- [Privacy details](https://slidesthief.com/docs/privacy.md): Local processing boundary, analytics defaults, and retention

## Machine-readable contracts

- [Product metadata](https://slidesthief.com/product-metadata.json): Names, version, input formats, and ratio presets

- [Manual corner schema](https://slidesthief.com/schemas/manual-quads.schema.json): Formal JSON Schema for manual corner files
